💧 Water: Drink at least half your bodyweight (lbs) in ounces of water each day.
🍽️ Meal Frequency: Break your total daily macros over 4–6 meals to maintain energy levels throughout the day.
🍬 Sweeteners: For anything sweet like sports drinks: ideally sweetened with monk fruit or stevia leaf extract.
⚖️ Tracking: Purchase a kitchen food scale to ensure accurate macro amounts in meals.
📊 Body Fat: Consider an electrical impedance device to track your body fat percentage periodically.
🌙 Protein Timing: Take casein protein powder at night — it digests slowly while you sleep to support muscle recovery.
⚡ Pre/Post Workout: Whey protein is ideal any time of day. Take Vitargo (powdered carb) around training for quick fuel and recovery.

🚀 On the Roadmap

These features are planned for the native app version of Milton’s Brain. They require capabilities a web app can't provide on its own (device health APIs, a community server, and on-device AI), so they'll arrive when the app moves to the App Store and Google Play.

⌚Wearable Integration
Automatic sync with Apple HealthKit and Google Fit to pull heart rate, calories, and sleep — feeding your recovery score and daily targets.
👥Social & Community
Leaderboards, in-app chat, and sharing personal records and workout summaries with friends.
📹Form Analyzer
Use your phone camera to analyze lift mechanics and give real-time form feedback using on-device pose estimation.

💬 This App Is Built Around You

🛟 Support & Privacy
Need help? Reach us anytime at support@trinityfitness.app — questions, bugs, or feature requests.
Privacy Policy
Milton’s Brain stores your profile, program, and progress on your own device. We do not sell your data. If you create an account or back up your data, it is used only to sync and restore your information. The optional AI coach sends your in-app context (goal, program, macros) to our coaching service to generate personalized replies; it is not used to identify you or sold to third parties. You can export or delete your data at any time from this screen.
Terms of Use
Milton’s Brain provides general fitness and nutrition guidance for informational purposes only and is not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional before starting any new exercise or nutrition program. Use of this app is at your own risk.
